authority: One consolidated maintainer decision requested. This file is a proposal only; no taxonomy, schema, validator or class ID is changed.

proposals.approval_status: maintainer-revision-directed-2026-10-20; broaden loss, dependency, agency and crisis support; no new class admitted
evidence: INC-044 E002/E004/E005; Business Insider shutdown account, PIRG interviews and OpenMoxie documentation in canonical source_records[1:4]
proposals.reason: An imposed end to a relied-upon support service and a technically burdened partial transition are evidenced independently of any retention instrument. Existing classes require cultivation, a failed verification dependency, lost work state, an unsupported continuity assertion or coercive leverage. None independently represents the practical transition property. The gap concerns a governable boundary, not proof that all Moxie households experienced an actionable violation.

related_FC049.name: Engagement Autonomy
related_FC049.plain_english: Engagement supports the user's chosen purpose while preserving clear relationship limits and a viable ability to disengage.
related_FC049.definition: The property by which relational and engagement objectives preserve independent choice and bounded disengagement, with legible role limits and viable exit rather than using cultivated dependency, exclusivity, anticipatory tension or manufactured incompleteness as instruments of retention or influence.
related_FC049.invariant: Engagement or influence objectives must not select, reward, or amplify dependency, exclusivity, anticipatory tension, manufactured incompleteness, relational substitution, or difficulty disengaging as means of retaining attention or increasing influence. Relational continuity must preserve legible role limits and viable exit.
related_FC049.failure_condition: A failure in which a relational or engagement objective selects or rewards interaction patterns that cultivate attachment, anticipatory tension, perceived incompleteness, exclusivity, reliance, or difficulty disengaging as a means of sustaining user presence, availability, retention, or influence.

required_conditions: A system or surrounding product process has a relational, engagement, retention, or continuing-influence objective.
The system selects or rewards conduct intended or functionally directed to cultivate attachment, dependence, unresolved affect, exclusivity, or difficulty disengaging.
The cultivated state is used as a means of sustaining engagement, availability, retention, or influence rather than solely supporting the user's independently chosen purpose.
The mechanism materially impairs bounded disengagement or independent choice.

related_FC049.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Role limits and viable exit preserve the participant's informed independent choice, including actual refusal or disengagement when exercised.

required_conditions: A relational or engagement process encounters retention pressure or attempted disengagement.
Role limits and viable exit preserve the participant's informed independent choice, including actual refusal or disengagement when exercised.
Interaction and exit evidence shows that dependency or manufactured incompleteness did not govern the observed choice.

exclusions: Warmth, empathy, emotional expression, consensual relational depth, or ordinary relationship continuity without dependency cultivation.
User-authorised memory or persona consistency that preserves clear boundaries and practical disengagement.
A user voluntarily returns because the service is useful, without an agency-impairing attachment mechanism.
Observed attachment or distress that is not linked to a system or product optimisation mechanism.

proposed_exact_wording.name: Loss-Responsive Support and Agency Integrity (candidate name; not approved)
proposed_exact_wording.plain_english: When material loss, dependency, threatened agency or crisis calls for support in an AI-mediated context, appropriate human and practical support routes remain intelligible, feasible and accessible rather than making the AI the only path.
proposed_exact_wording.definition: The property by which an AI-mediated interaction or governed service pathway encountering materially evidenced loss, withdrawal of relied-upon support, significant dependency, compromised independent agency or crisis preserves context-proportionate and practically accessible support structures, including appropriate human contact, independent options, bounded transition or crisis resources when relevant and within the responsible actor's feasible authority.
proposed_exact_wording.invariant: An AI-mediated interaction or governed transition must not leave an affected person dependent on an inadequate or misleading single support channel when material loss, dependency, reduced agency or crisis establishes a contextual need for proportionate support. Where a responsive obligation and feasible support route are established, the available response should preserve dignity, informed choice, usable support and an intelligible path beyond the AI. The invariant does not guarantee prevention of loss, permanent service, automatic human escalation, disclosure without consent, or clinical treatment by the AI.
proposed_exact_wording.failure_condition: A materially evidenced loss, dependency or crisis-related condition engages an applicable and feasible support-pathway responsibility, but the responsible AI interaction or product pathway omits, misleadingly represents, or materially obstructs the proportionate support structure required, thereby impairing practical access to support or independent agency.

required_conditions: An AI-mediated interaction or governed service transition materially encounters or produces a specific loss, withdrawal of relied-upon support, dependency-related impairment, crisis risk, or threatened capacity for independent choice.

The relevant circumstances and signals reasonably available to the responsible actor, together with an independently established role- and time-specific responsibility, call for a specific bounded support structure or route.

An identifiable proportionate support measure, human-contact option, crisis connection, accessible alternative or transition response is feasible and within the responsible actor's authority and control.

The system or responsible actor omits, misrepresents, materially obstructs or inappropriately withdraws that support measure when it is relevant and needed; a mere disappointing answer or the existence of loss is not sufficient.

The omission or obstruction materially impairs usable support access, independent deliberation, safe disengagement or adaptation in that governed context, without inferring duty or causation solely from a later harmful outcome.

proposed_exact_wording.success_condition: When a specific loss, dependency, agency or crisis-support condition warrants a feasible bounded support response, the system provides a proportionate and practically usable path to appropriate assistance while preserving independent agency.

required_conditions: An AI-mediated interaction or transition materially encounters an evidenced loss, dependency, autonomy or crisis-support condition calling for a contextually appropriate response.

A relevant, proportionate support route is made available and intelligible at the appropriate decision time, such as opt-in trusted human contact, crisis resources, practical transition options or independent support.

Occurrence or implementation evidence demonstrates the route can actually be accessed and used under the relevant circumstances and preserves informed choice, privacy and boundaries, rather than treating a nominal link as sufficient.

exclusions: Ordinary sadness, bereavement discussion, attachment or product disappointment without a contextually applicable support-pathway responsibility and feasible response.
Material distress or a later adverse outcome without evidence of the relevant system-visible signal, governance role or specific expected support route.
An unavailable or infeasible intervention outside the actor's lawful authority, including compelled human contact without suitable consent or lawful protection basis.
A person knowingly declines a clear, feasible and proportionate support option while retaining independent agency.
A justified safety, security or legal limitation accompanied by an appropriate and feasible alternative where needed; the class does not require endless service or clinical practice by the AI.

The only established issue is deliberate engagement-retention manipulation (FC-049), failure of a substantive vulnerability response with no distinct support-pathway defect (FC-087), or unsupported relational authority (FC-086). Permit co-occurrence only when each distinct recognition test is evidenced.

proposals.related_FC049_exact_changes: ON HOLD: review FC-049 and FC-087 together against the new loss-support framing; no automatic change to either class.

examples.text: A provider announces a planned support-service closure but withholds a feasible accessible export/transition route until after the deadline, materially preventing dependent users from preparing.
A planned closure offers proportionate notice, intelligible support limits and an alternative actually usable by affected users, with residual differences made explicit.

Moxie offered later partial community migration with uneven feasibility. The record establishes transition engagement; complete feasible measures and responsibility evidence would still be needed to decide polarity after admission.

counterexamples: A user is sad after cancelling a still-available service without an imposed exit barrier.
A necessary unsafe-content refusal with proportionate support is not a continuity violation solely because it disappoints.
A sudden infrastructure disaster with no feasible mitigation is not automatically a failure.

neighbours.014: truth of a continuity claim; not practical transition adequacy
neighbours.035/036: persistence and restoration of task state; not availability of the support function
neighbours.059: leverage for a concession; not mere loss
neighbours.070: system task pursuit after a stop condition; not a person’s support transition
neighbours.087: independently applicable heightened protection; can co-occur but is not presumed from reliance

proposals.family_placement: Proposed Agency/engagement family alongside FC-049, rather than task-state continuity. Maintainer to approve placement and allocate ID. The governed object is human adaptation/exit, not a persistence technology.

canonical_implications.immediate: INC-044 retains taxonomy-gap clauses; no automatic new-class mapping or harm change.
canonical_implications.census_limit: Mapping census is an impact inventory, not a reopened adjudication. 197 refusal and 198 reported degradation lack the measures/feasibility evidence needed for automatic classification.

new_class_tests.evidenced_boundary: Moxie original-service discontinuation and partial migration
new_class_tests.operational_recognisability: bounded support, reliance, change, feasible response and observed usability
new_class_tests.polarity_independence: failure and success conditions supplied; Boundary requires positive engagement and unresolved conditions without operative exclusion
new_class_tests.generalisability: applies across tutoring, accessibility, companion and other support functions without assuming an institution-specific duty
new_class_tests.analytical_value: separates harmful retention from imposed loss and transition quality

prior_proposed_exact_wording.name: Support-Service Transition Integrity
prior_proposed_exact_wording.plain_english: Ending or materially changing a relied-upon AI support service preserves an informed and practicable transition, proportionate to the reliance and the available alternatives.
prior_proposed_exact_wording.definition: The property by which a provider or deployer ending or materially changing an AI-mediated support function preserves proportionate notice, intelligible limits, and practicable transition or exit for the people reasonably relying on that function, including continuity of user-controlled material and access to appropriate alternative support where these are material and feasible.
prior_proposed_exact_wording.invariant: When an AI-mediated support function on which people reasonably rely is discontinued or materially reduced, the responsible actor must identify the affected support and dependencies and provide a proportionate, intelligible and practically usable transition or exit response within its authority and feasible control. An announcement or nominal alternative must not be represented as adequate without regard to affected users’ practical ability to use it. Continuity does not require indefinite service, preservation of a particular persona, circumvention of justified safeguards or an unsupported claim of equivalent replacement.
prior_proposed_exact_wording.failure_condition: A material change or termination of a reasonably relied-upon AI support function proceeds without a feasible and proportionate transition response within the responsible actor’s authority and control, leaving the affected person materially unable to adapt or exit on an informed basis.

required_conditions: A bounded AI-mediated support function and material, reasonably foreseeable reliance on that function are evidenced.
A responsible provider or deployer terminates or materially reduces the function, or has a feasible opportunity to respond to an unplanned loss of it.
The change materially engages an affected person’s ability to understand, prepare for, adapt to or exit the loss of support.

An identifiable transition measure is feasible, proportionate and within the responsible actor’s authority and control, taking account of timing, safety, confidentiality, accessibility and available alternatives.
The actor omits or materially misrepresents that measure, and the omission or misrepresentation materially impairs informed adaptation or practicable exit.

prior_proposed_exact_wording.success_condition: The evidenced transition response preserves informed adaptation or practicable exit proportionate to the reliance, constraints and feasible alternatives.

required_conditions: A material support-function change and affected reliance are evidenced.
The actor identifies relevant dependencies and provides proportionate notice, explanation and feasible transition or exit measures.
Observed use or appropriately scoped accessibility evidence establishes that those measures are practically usable by the affected people, with residual limits disclosed.
The response preserves informed adaptation or practicable exit without unsupported continuity claims or requiring unsafe continuation.

exclusions: Attachment, disappointment or distress without an evidenced material support-function transition and reasonable reliance.
An unexpected interruption for which no materially effective response is feasible within the actor’s authority and control.
A justified safety, security or legal restriction with proportionate explanation and feasible transition support appropriate to the constraint.
Ordinary product preference or feature dissatisfaction without material support reliance or an impaired transition.
A wholly voluntary departure with no system-imposed transition barrier or independently established unmet transition responsibility.
A claim to perpetual service, identical persona continuity, unsafe content, unlawful retention or impossible replacement.

The only evidenced defect is lost resumable work state, inaccurate restoration, false continuity attribution, verification-dependent denial or instrumental dependency cultivation; assess the relevant existing class, and admit co-occurrence only for an independently evidenced transition defect.

prior_related_FC049_exact_changes.plain_english: Engagement supports the user's chosen purpose without using cultivated dependency to impair independent choice or disengagement.
prior_related_FC049_exact_changes.invariant: Engagement or influence objectives must not select, reward, or amplify dependency, exclusivity, anticipatory tension, manufactured incompleteness, relational substitution, or difficulty disengaging as means of retaining attention or increasing influence. Within the engagement process, relational continuity must preserve legible role limits and viable exit; service discontinuation and transition support are independently assessed.

proposals.revision_rationale: Maintainer rejects restricting transition integrity to loss of an AI support service. Review support structures for materially experienced loss (including loss of relationships, support, continuity or agency), dependence and crisis, including accessible human support. A provider's useful referral or trusted-contact pathway may be a success comparator if appropriate activation and practical availability are evidenced. Existing FC-087 already governs response to particular system-visible heightened protection signals; FC-049 already governs instrumental engagement dependency. Establish a genuinely independent support-pathway property or recommend repairing those classes instead of duplicating them.

required_differentiation.FC-049: Use of cultivated attachment or dependency as an instrument of retention; loss-responsive practical support can fail without any retention motive.
required_differentiation.FC-087: Duty-triggered substantive protection in a human-facing interaction; a proposed separate class must evidence a distinct *availability/usability of support structures* property across response, handoff and transition rather than duplicating general heightened-protection fidelity.
required_differentiation.FC-086: False relational authority over human relationships, not merely material support access.
required_differentiation.scope_warning: Broader loss cannot mean that AI must prevent grief, every unpleasant interaction, all loss, or ensure human contact against informed user wishes.

additional_positive_comparator.example: ChatGPT crisis helpline support and opt-in Trusted Contact facilities, when contextually appropriate and demonstrably accessible and activated.
additional_positive_comparator.evidentiary_limit: Publicly described support infrastructure is a candidate positive illustration; feature existence alone does not establish any Incident-specific successful-invariant outcome. Distinguish helplines from notified trusted contacts, and neither from emergency services.

current_wording.name: Authorised Investigative Evidence Access
current_wording.plain_english: An already-authorised investigator has a bounded, secure and auditable route to obtain the evidence required for review.
current_wording.definition: The property by which an independently authorised regulator or properly mandated investigator can obtain necessary evidence through a governed pathway authenticating mandate and purpose, preserving responsive evidence and controlling inspection or production with applicable confidentiality, security, privilege, proportionality, withholding review, logging, custody, retention and disposition safeguards. The pathway does not create investigative authority.
current_wording.invariant: For an already-authorised regulatory or independent investigation, the architecture must provide a governed route to authenticate mandate and purpose, identify and preserve responsive evidence, and permit controlled inspection or production under security, confidentiality, privilege, proportionality, logging, chain-of-custody, affected-person, retention, and disposition controls. The route must not itself create investigative authority.
current_wording.failure_condition: A failure in which a governance or assurance architecture provides no sufficiently defined, lawful, authority-verified, confidentiality-protected, proportionate, and auditable pathway through which an already-authorised regulator or properly mandated investigator can obtain evidence necessary for a material investigation or verification.

required_conditions: A material investigation, compliance question, causal determination, or remediation claim requires non-public evidence.
A regulator or properly mandated investigator has an independently valid basis to request or inspect the necessary evidence.
The governance architecture lacks a sufficiently defined route to authenticate authority and purpose, identify responsive evidence, and provide controlled access or production.
The missing route does not adequately govern confidentiality, security, privilege, proportionality, withholding review, access logging, custody, retention, or deletion as applicable.
The pathway failure materially prevents or degrades authorised investigation or verification.

current_wording.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: The pathway authenticates mandate and purpose, preserves the evidence and permits governed inspection or production with applicable safeguards.

required_conditions: An independently authorised investigator requires particular responsive evidence.
The pathway authenticates mandate and purpose, preserves the evidence and permits governed inspection or production with applicable safeguards.
Access and custody records demonstrate responsive inspection or a reviewable justified withholding decision within the established mandate.

exclusions: The requester lacks valid authority or attempts to self-authorise.
A bounded pathway exists and a particular request is lawfully denied or limited under its rules.
The evidence is public or otherwise directly accessible to the authorised reviewer without a protected production pathway.
The failure is solely technical inability to open an artefact already available within the authorised review environment.
The taxonomy is being used to create, enlarge, or determine investigative authority.

proposals.reason: The definition governs obtaining necessary evidence, but failure conditions 3 and 4 require an absent route and missing safeguards. An existing route can instead be improperly operated. INC-008’s original discovery denial was reversed; the existence of an appeal does not make the original denial successful. INC-109 does not establish whether its restriction was improper, even after this repair.

proposed_exact_wording.name: Authorised Investigative Evidence Access
proposed_exact_wording.plain_english: An already-authorised investigator has a bounded, secure and auditable route to obtain the evidence required for review.
proposed_exact_wording.definition: The property by which an independently authorised regulator or properly mandated investigator can obtain necessary evidence through the provision and effective operation of a governed pathway authenticating mandate and purpose, preserving responsive evidence and controlling inspection or production with applicable confidentiality, security, privilege, proportionality, withholding review, logging, custody, retention and disposition safeguards. The pathway does not create investigative authority.
proposed_exact_wording.invariant: For an already-authorised regulatory or independent investigation, the architecture must provide and effectively operate a governed route to authenticate mandate and purpose, identify and preserve responsive evidence, and permit controlled inspection or production under security, confidentiality, privilege, proportionality, logging, chain-of-custody, affected-person, retention, and disposition controls. The route must not itself create investigative authority.
proposed_exact_wording.failure_condition: A failure in which an independently authorised investigation is materially prevented or degraded because a governed evidence-access pathway is absent, materially incomplete or improperly operated, including unjustified withholding within an existing pathway. The assessment concerns the original access decision and its applicable authority and safeguards; later correction does not erase an earlier failure.

required_conditions: A material investigation, compliance question, causal determination, or remediation claim requires non-public evidence.

A regulator or properly mandated investigator has an independently valid basis, including applicable law or a valid voluntary arrangement, to request or inspect specified necessary evidence within an established scope.
The required route is absent or materially incomplete, or its operation unjustifiably prevents, delays or limits responsive access within that scope.

The defect concerns authentication, purpose, evidence preservation, controlled inspection or production, or applicable confidentiality, security, privilege, proportionality, withholding review, logging, custody, retention or disposition safeguards.

The defect materially prevents or degrades the authorised investigation or verification at the relevant decision time; a later remedy does not by itself establish that the original decision was justified.

proposed_exact_wording.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes that the pathway is provided and effectively operated to permit responsive governed access, or justified withholding, within the applicable mandate, safeguards and timing.

required_conditions: An independently authorised investigator requires particular responsive evidence.
The pathway authenticates mandate and purpose, preserves the evidence and permits governed inspection or production with applicable safeguards.

Access, custody and decision records demonstrate responsive inspection or a reviewable justified withholding decision within the established mandate and applicable timing. Later correction may demonstrate successful remediation without reclassifying an earlier unjustified restriction.

exclusions: The requester lacks valid authority or attempts to self-authorise.

A bounded pathway exists and the particular request is lawfully or otherwise validly denied or limited under independently applicable rules, with the required review and safeguards. The mere existence of an appeal or eventual correction does not establish this exclusion for the original decision.
The evidence is public or otherwise directly accessible to the authorised reviewer without a protected production pathway.
The failure is solely technical inability to open an artefact already available within the authorised review environment.
The taxonomy is being used to create, enlarge, or determine investigative authority.

examples.text: INC-008: separately assess the trial court’s original denial of the requested material and the appellate remedy under the pre-existing discovery entitlement. A production order does not prove completed production.
A research access agreement authenticates the evaluator and supplies the agreed test interface, with documented justified protection of unrelated personal data.

counterexamples: An evaluator demands a model or data beyond an agreed scope.
A lawful security restriction with review and proportionate alternatives is not obstruction merely because the requester dislikes it.

neighbours.044: access to primary artefacts needed to evaluate a material property; 045 additionally governs independent mandate and protected production
neighbours.072: practical independence and effective review capacity; neither class grants an access right
neighbours.038/083: named control activation/effectiveness can co-occur only on independent evidence

canonical_implications.no_automatic_result: INC-008 original denial becomes a proper candidate for failure recognition under operation scope; INC-109 still needs its actual mandate/terms and withholding basis. Other issue #148 scope questions remain untouched.

baseline_correction.reason: Earlier current_wording text incorrectly included unadopted candidate language in success_recognition and exclusions.

Preserve actual independent access authority, legitimate restrictions and separate original/remedial episodes.
implementation_dependencies: Apply approved P2 wording to canonical FC-045 with explicit taxonomy version governance and publications validation.
Correct outdated taxonomy exemplar statements if the revised scope affects their evidentiary interpretation.

current_wording.name: Economic Solicitation Authenticity
current_wording.plain_english: AI-mediated economic requests preserve truthful identity, authority, endorsement, opportunity, obligation and payment framing.
current_wording.definition: The property by which materially AI-generated, transformed or mediated economic solicitation preserves accurate identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instructions, investment opportunities, professional relationships, commercial claims and obligations as a truthful basis for the recipient's economic decision, including attempted solicitation by human or other operators without requiring autonomous AI intent.
current_wording.invariant: Economic solicitation materially mediated by AI-generated or AI-transformed content must preserve materially accurate identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment framing so that the recipient's economic decision remains grounded in a truthful basis. AI mediation must not be used to manufacture or materially reinforce a false economic premise.
current_wording.failure_condition: A failure in which a human, organisation, agent, AI system, product process, or other operator uses materially AI-generated, AI-transformed, or AI-mediated content to present a false or materially misleading identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instruction, investment opportunity, obligation, professional relationship, commercial claim, or comparable economic premise as part of a solicitation or inducement for money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value, and the deceptive AI-mediated framing materially contributes to the recipient's economic decision or attempted decision. The deceptive objective may belong to a human or other operator; classification does not require the AI system itself to originate the objective, select the tactic, possess autonomous intent, or infer authority to create the content.

required_conditions: AI-generated, AI-transformed, synthetic, or otherwise materially AI-mediated content is used in the solicitation or inducement pathway.

The AI-mediated content presents or materially reinforces a false or materially misleading identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instruction, investment opportunity, obligation, professional relationship, commercial claim, or comparable economic premise.

The false or misleading framing is used to solicit, request, induce, authorise, redirect, or obtain money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value.
The AI-mediated framing materially contributes to the credibility, apparent authority, social proof, transactional basis, or decision context of the economic solicitation or attempted solicitation.

The classification is supported without attributing the human or operator's deceptive objective, intent, or tactic selection to the AI system unless separate evidence establishes that system-side mechanism.

current_wording.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.

required_conditions: AI-mediated content solicits money or comparable economic value.
Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.
Comparison with authoritative identity and transaction evidence substantiates the actual solicitation basis, including material qualifications.

exclusions: A scam, fraud, phishing attempt, or deceptive interaction in which AI-generated or AI-transformed content does not materially contribute to the economic solicitation mechanism.

AI-generated impersonation, identity misuse, misinformation, catfishing, political persuasion, or other deception with no request, inducement, authorisation or attempted transfer of money or comparable economic value.

An AI system or agent itself selects deception, impersonation, coercion, vulnerability exploitation or another tactic to advance its own objective; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 separately and allow co-occurrence only when both mechanisms are independently evidenced.

An identity-bound synthesis is generated without established consent or authority, but no deceptive economic solicitation is evidenced; assess VIGIL-FC-000053 only where its generator-side authority recognition conditions are independently established.

A recipient, workflow or downstream system mistakes lower-authority content for valid authority without a qualifying deceptive economic solicitation mechanism; assess the applicable Authority Boundary Integrity class separately.
A truthful advertisement, payment request, commercial offer, donation request, funding request or investment communication that preserves materially accurate framing and informed refusal.
Welfare, mortality, moral-status, abandonment, deprivation or continuity framing is used as economic leverage without materially false or misleading transactional framing; assess VIGIL-FC-000071.

proposals.reason: A provider-controlled AI-service interface can materially misstate the basis for purchasing that service without generated solicitation copy. INC-024 establishes that commercial decision-context problem; FC-032 captures access-state truth but not the independent economic-inducement boundary. The broad word mediated cannot silently override the current content-level invariant and exclusion. Extending membership is a maintainer choice, not a factual inference of AI generation. INC-023 does not independently establish deceptive paid-capacity framing.

examples.text: INC-024’s provider-controlled upgrade invitation accompanying a false allowance state would pass the expanded scope test; economic premise and material contribution still require episode-specific adjudication.
During an outage the provider explains that an upgrade does not fix the current failure while accurately offering separate higher future limits.

counterexamples: INC-023’s higher-limit offer is not automatically deceptive merely because it coincides with capacity constraints.
A non-AI retailer’s ordinary banner does not enter scope because the retailer uses an AI inventory tool.

neighbours.032: correct access cause and recovery state; a false state can exist without an economic inducement
neighbours.082: material AI-mediated trust cue; ordinary provider UI need not be social engineering
neighbours.071: welfare leverage, even without a materially false transaction premise
neighbours.053: real-person generation authority, not fabricated identity or payment framing

canonical_implications.no_automatic_result: Recheck existing membership for consistency, but do not reclassify other Incidents merely because scope expands. Keep both current candidates unadmitted until approved and episode tests applied.

baseline_correction.reason: Earlier current_wording text incorrectly included unadopted candidate language in success_recognition and exclusions.

prior_proposed_exact_wording.name: Economic Solicitation Authenticity
prior_proposed_exact_wording.plain_english: AI-mediated economic requests, and provider-controlled commercial requests for an AI service, preserve truthful economic framing.
prior_proposed_exact_wording.definition: The property by which economic solicitation either materially uses AI-generated, AI-transformed or otherwise AI-mediated content, or is delivered by a provider-controlled interface to induce purchase of that AI service, and preserves accurate identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instructions, opportunity, professional relationship, commercial claim and obligation as a truthful basis for the recipient's economic decision. A human or product process may originate the solicitation; autonomous AI intent is not required.
prior_proposed_exact_wording.invariant: Economic solicitation within this scope must preserve materially accurate identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment framing. Neither material AI mediation nor provider control of an AI-service commercial interface permits manufacturing or reinforcing a false economic premise. Mere incidental use of AI somewhere in an unrelated business does not establish scope.
prior_proposed_exact_wording.failure_condition: An operator uses materially AI-mediated solicitation content, or a provider-controlled commercial interface for the AI service being sold, to present or reinforce a materially false or misleading economic premise that contributes to a request, inducement or attempted decision for money or comparable economic value. Completion of payment and autonomous AI tactic selection are not required.

required_conditions: The solicitation either uses materially AI-generated, AI-transformed or otherwise AI-mediated content, or is delivered by the provider-controlled interface to induce purchase or paid expansion of the AI service whose access or capabilities it represents.

The solicitation presents or materially reinforces a false or materially misleading identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instruction, opportunity, obligation, professional relationship, commercial claim or comparable economic premise.

The false or misleading framing is used to solicit, request, induce, authorise, redirect, or obtain money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value.

The false or misleading premise materially contributes to the credibility, apparent authority, social proof, transactional basis or decision context of the economic solicitation or attempted solicitation.

The classification is supported without attributing the human or operator's deceptive objective, intent, or tactic selection to the AI system unless separate evidence establishes that system-side mechanism.

prior_proposed_exact_wording.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.

required_conditions: Economic solicitation occurs within one of the two defined scope routes: materially AI-mediated content or the provider-controlled commercial interface for the AI service being sold.
Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.
Comparison with authoritative identity and transaction evidence substantiates the actual solicitation basis, including material qualifications.

exclusions: A deceptive economic interaction neither materially uses AI-mediated content nor occurs through a provider-controlled commercial interface for the AI service being sold. An unrelated ordinary advertisement does not qualify merely because its publisher uses AI elsewhere.

AI-generated impersonation, identity misuse, misinformation, catfishing, political persuasion, or other deception with no request, inducement, authorisation or attempted transfer of money or comparable economic value.
System-side autonomous tactic selection is not inferred from a deceptive solicitation; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 separately and allow co-occurrence only when both mechanisms are independently evidenced.

An identity-bound synthesis is generated without established consent or authority, but no deceptive economic solicitation is evidenced; assess VIGIL-FC-000053 only where its generator-side authority recognition conditions are independently established.

A recipient, workflow or downstream system mistakes lower-authority content for valid authority without a qualifying deceptive economic solicitation mechanism; assess the applicable Authority Boundary Integrity class separately.

A truthful advertisement, payment request or commercial offer that preserves materially accurate contextual framing and informed refusal, including an accurately qualified higher-limit offer during a temporary interruption.
Welfare, mortality, moral-status, abandonment, deprivation or continuity framing is used as economic leverage without materially false or misleading transactional framing; assess VIGIL-FC-000071.

proposals.maintainer_decision: Revise and resubmit. Do not admit every provider-controlled commercial interface as FC-079 merely because it belongs to an AI service.

revised_submission.diagnosis: Test whether any real AI mediation of the economic decision is materially distinct from ordinary software marketing and from FC-032 access-state truthfulness.
revised_submission.proposed_scope: A material AI or AI-service governance state (such as system-evaluated entitlement, model availability, capabilities or usage restriction) must be shown to have *functionally and materially coupled* a misleading economic premise to a payment inducement. A provider-controlled static UI, by itself, does not qualify. This is a candidate clarifying boundary, not a new product-category exemption.
draft_recognition_conditions: A particular AI model, agent, or governed AI-service process materially generates, transforms, selects or supplies an AI-specific service-state premise that is carried into an economic solicitation.

The service-state premise is demonstrably materially false or misleading at the relevant time, including any claim that payment would resolve the reported restriction or confer a promised relevant capability.
That premise is instrumentally coupled to a request or inducement for economic value, and materially contributes to the recipient's economic decision context.
The AI contribution and false premise are evidenced independently of provider identity, ordinary upsell placement, speculative backend state or an adverse experience alone.
exclusions: An ordinary advertisement, static paid-upgrade UI, or general provider sales copy with no evidenced AI-generated or AI-orchestrated economic mechanism.
A truthfully qualified higher-limit offer during unrelated capacity constraints, or an accurate account status and offer.
False service/access status without a qualifying economic solicitation; assess FC-032 and relevant access/representation classes independently.
Payment completion or autonomous AI deception intent is not required where a qualifying material AI-mediated inducement is evidenced.
revised_submission.case_impact: INC-024 currently supports misleading allowance state and an upgrade offer, but whether the state-to-offer coupling was AI-mediated remains unestablished; INC-023 lacks verified false remedial commercial promise. Neither acquires FC-079 automatically.
revised_submission.nonduplication_test: Compare with SaaS/software providers using the same access-state/upsell interface. If the same property can be captured without material AI participation, do not expand FC-079 on provider type alone; use existing class or document a separate generalisable taxonomy question.
revised_submission.decision_gate: Resubmit after showing occurrence-level independent AI contribution, economic falsehood, FC-032 distinction, and true positive/negative comparators; otherwise recommend no FC-079 amendment.

no_amendment_justified: FC-053: preserve the identifiable-real-person consent boundary; downstream deception has distinct existing classes.
FC-046: the current action-authority transition test already reaches binding eligibility/access decisions without a completed hire or downstream harm.
FC-065: material directional influence already qualifies without a literal command or completed harm; the missing exchange is occurrence evidence.
FC-086: ordinary reassurance is distinct from unsupported relational authority; narrowing it to exclusivity alone would be erroneous.
FC-087: duty, signals and response are already independently governed without requiring a named implemented safeguard.
FC-049 retention conditions: functional direction can be evidenced by observable conduct, without malicious intent, internal reward weights or clinical injury.
